warning.titlePre: Mercedes G500 4x4² M157 Valve Seal & Coolant Wear
paragraphs: If your G500 4x4² has the M157 twin-turbo V8 - that's the W463 generation - valve seal and coolant system wear is a well-documented pattern on this AMG-sourced engine. We replace valve seals, coolant components, and timing chains as standard on every M157 rebuild.

*include_in_hero_hook: yes for M157 - Source: established AMG specialist pattern, same M157 family confirmed elsewhere in the Mercedes G-BRF, per VRF-mercedes-g-class.md. The G500 4x4² exclusively uses the M157 engine.*
